purpose: Teach: 発泡/源流/ソプラノ/ジェンダーフリー/右腕/語尾/踏切/出走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、発泡素材を環境配慮型に切り替えろ
lines.en: Switch our foam packaging to eco-friendly materials.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive command. Sharp attack on first word. No softening — this is an instruction, not a suggestion. Steady eye contact across the desk.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業の源流を見直す戦略を立てます
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop a strategy that rethinks our supply chain from the source.
lines.style: Earnest, taking note. Slight nod on "Understood." Voice carries the weight of the commitment — this matters and he knows it. Clear and measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内合唱団でソプラノパートを募集しろ
lines.en: Establish a soprano recruitment drive for the company choir.
lines.style: Same clipped authority as before. Direct, unambiguous. A statement of fact masquerading as instruction. No room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ジェンダーフリーな職場を整備します
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure the workplace is set up to be gender-inclusive.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slightly more relaxed than the first response — he's tracking the pattern now. Careful enunciation on "gender-inclusive." Professional but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社長の右腕的役員を選任しろ
lines.en: Appoint an executive to serve as the president's right hand.
lines.style: Final instruction, delivered with the same clipped certainty. Slightly slower pace on "right hand" — letting the weight of the position settle. No embellishment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のプレゼン語尾も丁寧にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll also make sure our staff presentations end with appropriate politeness.
lines.style: Quieter now. He's catching the rhythm of these directives. Voice slightly tighter — this one lands differently. Obedient but thinking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場近くの踏切事故対策を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen safety measures at the railway crossing near the factory.
lines.style: Shift in tone here — this one is serious in a different way. Slower, more deliberate. The word "safety" carries genuine weight. This isn't a corporate memo, this is about lives.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の出走、つまり投入時期を慎重に決めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll also time the launch of our new product carefully and strategically.
lines.style: Final response, delivered quietly. He's understood the test. Voice steady, no hesitation. A small exhale before "strategically" — he's passed through something.
